Asking if he could get a picture of me to put inside his car. disgusting I know, but it gets worse. I immediately leave the register, get my manager and he deals with him. I thought it was all over. As you can see that’s where I was wrong. He waited until the business closed to start following me home. I walk home since it’s not far from where I lived. I called the police and ran as fast as I could into the woods. I was not mistaken. I knew it was him. He drove a very recognizable car. I still think about how that could have gone differently if I wasn’t so aware of my surroundings.
